exposure: transabdominal transvesical vesicovaginal fistula repair with interposition flap
iatrogenic cause of VVF (hysterectomy, Cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 46 patients who underwent vesicovaginal fistula repair between June 2019 and June 2024 in Afghanistan.
finding: Transabdominal VVF repair with an interposition flap, utilizing a technique that preserves the fistulous tract, achieved a 100% success rate with no major complications in this cohort.
mod_finding: 11 of the iatrogenic vesicovaginal fistulas in this cohort followed Cesarean section.
